description: Joint Research Centre: storm and wind hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 56 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about storm and wind hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Urban Damage Assessment Following Storm Kristin in Central Portugal (2; Storm in Latvia (2024-07-28); Wind storm in Sweden (2013-10-29); Hurricane Fiona in Canada (2022-09-24). Formats seen: SHP, ZIP, GDB, NETCDF, PNG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is European Commission reuse notice, CC-BY-4.0, as linked on the portal listing (http://data.jrc.ec.europa.eu/licence/not_available). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
